title: Chat channels
subtitle: Connect messaging apps and decide who may talk to your agents.

accounts.title: Connected accounts
accounts.emptyDescription: Install a chat plugin, then add a bot token in Plugin settings. Pairing codes live on the Pairing tab.
accounts.noPluginsDescription: Install a chat plugin first. Pairing and account lists come from those plugins.

pairing.title: Pairing
pairing.description: Create a 6-digit code, send it to the person in chat, and they type /pair 123456. Unknown senders stay blocked until paired or allowed.
pairing.requireLabel: Require a pairing code before agents reply
pairing.noCodesHint: Create a code, then share it in the chat app.
pairing.pendingEmptyHint: When someone messages a protected bot, they appear here.
pairing.howTo: In chat, send /pair followed by the 6-digit code.

errors.codeFailed: Could not create a pairing code

confirm.revokeDescription: They will need a new pairing code before the agent replies again.
